title: The EU says it is considering designating WhatsApp a "very large platform", after WhatsApp published user numbers above the DSA threshold in February 2025 (Louise Breusch Rasmussen/Reuters)
summary: Louise Breusch Rasmussen / Reuters: The EU says it is considering designating WhatsApp a “very large platform”, after WhatsApp published user numbers above the DSA threshold in February 2025 — The European Commission is considering recategorizing Meta's (META.O) WhatsApp messaging service to make it more responsible …
contentText:
Louise Breusch Rasmussen / Reuters :

The EU says it is considering designating WhatsApp a “very large platform”, after Meta published WhatsApp user numbers above the DSA threshold in February 2025   —  The European Commission is considering recategorizing Meta's (META.O) WhatsApp messaging service to make it more responsible …
